title: Unify Docker base images and enable remote build cache for CI speedups
creator: Amaya Chen
description: Reduce CI build times and maintenance overhead by standardizing our Docker base images across services, adopting BuildKit remote cache export/import, and upgrading the lint/toolchain images. This ticket covers: (1) audit of current base images (node/python/golang variants), (2) creation of canonical multi-stage base images (builder/runtime/distroless variants), (3) enabling BuildKit cache-to-remote (s3/gcs) for CI workers, (4) bumping linter/toolchain images (ESLint/Prettier/golangci-lint) to current supported versions and pinning toolchain in CI, and (5) migration plan for 20+ repos with minimal disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical base image repository created and published (tagging strategy documented)
CI pipelines can push/pull build cache to/from remote cache and demonstrate cache hits in >75% of PR builds
Average cold build time for sample monorepo reduced by >=40% and typical PR build time reduced by >=50%
Lint/toolchain image versions updated and failing lints addressed or triaged in associated repos
Migration plan with canary rollouts defined and first 4 repositories migrated successfully
Runbook updated with rollback steps and cost estimate for remote cache storage
comments: 2026-01-21 - Kickoff: collected inventory from 38 repos. Majority use node:14-slim or python:3.9-buster; ~7 repos use custom heavyweight images. Action: align on node-18, python-3.11, go1.21 as canonical targets.

2026-02-05 - Decision: prefer multi-stage images + distroless runtime for security and smaller layer sizes. Trade-offs discussed: distroless breaks shell debugging; we will keep a debug tag with busybox for troubleshooting.

2026-02-12 - PoC: implemented builder/runtime images and published to internal registry. 1st PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/128 - feedback from Security: add SBOM generation step and SCAN in pipeline (in progress).

2026-02-20 - Build cache PoC: tested BuildKit cache export to S3-compatible endpoint. Cold build 18m -> warm rebuild 4m for sample-service. Observed stable cache hit on incremental builds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-configs/pull/67

2026-02-27 - CI change: switched from docker:dind to moby/buildkit engine on self-hosted agents to support cache export. Ops note: need to increase disk throughput on mac1 runners by 20% to avoid I/O stalls.

2026-03-03 - Linter upgrades: bumped ESLint to 8.x and Prettier 3.x in canonical lint image. Found ~120 lint failures across 12 repos; created ENG-9461 to address autofix migrations. Temporarily allow rule "no-unsafe-optional-chaining" relax for three repos until fixes land.

2026-03-07 - Security review: SBOM generation added (syft) and uploaded to artifacts. Security requested ephemeral credentials for cache writes — implementing short-lived STS tokens for S3 writes (design in https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ci-cache-auth).

2026-03-10 - Migration status: 4 repos migrated (auth-service, inference-runtime, web-console, observability). CI minutes for migrated repos dropped ~48% month-over-month. Next wave of 8 repos scheduled for 2026-03-22 cycle.
Review notes (2026-03-05) from Platform: ensure cache key includes go-mod checksum / node-lockfile hash to avoid invalid hits.

Follow-up: estimate cost for remote cache storage and retention policy. Proposed retention: keep last 30 days of cache artifacts; older entries pruned. Ops to provide monthly cost estimate by 2026-03-18.
